**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Christabel](../persons.html#329)
The elder sister may be a good modification and pray do you – or [FMP](../persons.html#1160) invent a love story to work in.[^1]
No Robber appears so do pray write him, also Geo III and the beggar. I have done a White Ship.

There ought I fancy to be about 30, and I have 28 in my eye or written out ie if I take two Whittingtons.

What do you think of the baby Pretender in his nurses’ arms under the Church wall in his mother’s flight?

In haste
your affectionate

C M Yonge
I got [Mrs Argles](../persons.html#57) ([Dr Davys](../persons.html#411)’ daughter) to tell me over again the story of the Pedigree.

It is all right

[^1]: Endorsed in another hand \'1882\'.

[^2]: i.e., to [The Miz Maze](../books.html#165) the novel they were writing in collaboration.

The rest of the letter seems to relate to a different project, however.
